metrics.method: Full 739-message history (2025-08-25 to 2026-09-01), 301 client messages. client_questions_total = client messages containing a direct question. unanswered_over_24h = questions read in thread order that never received a substantive on-topic answer from any ALTR-side sender within 24h (a bare @tag, an automated broadcast or an unrelated reply does not count as an answer); a simple 'next team message' timer scores 0 here because the group carries constant broadcast traffic, which is itself the finding. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive non-templated, non-billing ALTR messages (excluding DMCA/leak recaps, reel-inspo link dumps and invoice/withdrawal reminders); the equivalent figure counting every ALTR message, including automation, is 9.3 days. promises_* = manual enumeration of explicit forward-looking commitments by ALTR-side senders ('I'll get back to you', 'we'll fix this', scheduled deliverables, stated guarantees), scored kept only where completion is visible in the chat.
